program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_b@j, !is_a@i & is_b@i)
h1_2 = leftmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i, !is_b@i)
h1_3 = rightmost(is_a@i & !is_b@i, is_a@i)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !h1_2@i, is_b@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i)
h2_2 = leftmost(!is_a@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i & !h1_1@j, is_b@i & !h1_2@i & !h1_3@i)
accept = !is_bos & is_a & !is_b & !h2_1 & !h2_2

output accept
